system.description:
You spin your weapon with chakra and quickly surround your target within the spin. Select a point you can see in range as you surround the area with segments of your weapon before retracting it, collapsing it on all creatures within a 10-foot radius centered on the point. All creatures in range must make a Strength saving throw taking your [Weapons damage] +3d8 and are knocked Prone and Restrained on a failed save, and only half damage with no conditions on a success. At the start of a Restrained creatures turn, they remake the save, ending the conditions on a success.

Chain 2: You can move all Restrained creatures 20 feet as a bonus action on your turn. They must remain within your weapons range otherwise; they break free automatically ending this jutsu’s effect on them.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8
